scope: Windows x64 synthetic registered mode-1 party: original-DLL status, full result CSV and cumulative journal comparisons. All 35 zero-ID enemy skill slots are tested. One nonzero normal action with null conditions selects ENEMY1 (itself) at rates 100 and 0; RANDOM and four profession selectors damage the expected living neutral player at rate 100. With normal slot 0 and skill slot 1 both registered, the latter targets the mercenary and causes observed damage; both actions executing is not proven. Dead-member fallback, other nonzero slots, targets and triggers are unverified or rejected. Twelve cases cover player effects and two waves. Actual C# NativeRegisteredBattle adapter is compiled/executed against the rebuilt DLL with original result/journal comparisons. No real resources, Unity engine, ARM64 or iPhone execution was tested.
